# Open tools and reproducible workflows

Code is part of the scientific record. These projects expose models, numerical methods, and benchmark instances so that results can be inspected and extended.

<div class="software-meta"><span>Julia</span><span>Tensor networks</span></div>

## SpinGlassPEPS.jl

A tensor-network package for Ising-like optimization on quasi-two-dimensional graphs, developed with collaborators in the EuroHPC-PL project.

[Repository](https://github.com/euro-hpc-pl/SpinGlassPEPS.jl){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary} [Paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2352711025002249){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.software-card}
<div class="software-meta"><span>Python</span><span>Annealing</span></div>

## DWaveDynamics

Reference implementations for mapping quantum-inspired dynamical models to QUBO instances and comparing quantum and classical annealers.

[Repository](https://github.com/atg205/DWaveDynamics){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary} [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.03952){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.software-card}
<div class="software-meta"><span>Python</span><span>Phase space</span></div>

## Wigner-function methods

Research code supporting phase-space studies of critical quantum systems and nonclassicality.

[Repository](https://github.com/MoorishQubit/wigner){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary} [Related paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.02680){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.software-card}
<div class="software-meta"><span>HPC</span><span>Examples</span></div>

## HPC samples

Compact examples and job scripts used in high-performance computing workflows.

[Repository](https://github.com/MoorishQubit/hpc_samples){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
:::
